methods_quotes.q: t-tests were used to assess vaccination coverage differences by survey year (2014 compared with 2013), age, sex, race/ethnicity, and poverty status.
Differences were considered statistically significant at p<0.05.
Coverage estimates are based on provider-reported vaccination histories for adolescents with adequate provider data.
Sampling weights were adjusted for dual-frame (landline and cell phone), nonresponse, noncoverage, and overlapping samples of mixed telephone users.
